channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter – Bias and Credibility (alreporter.com)

item.title: March 31 deadline for CHOOSE Act applications approaches
item.description: The governor urged eligible Alabama families to apply for or renew educational funding through the state's school choice program by March 31.

item.title: Alabama State Parks: Lash’s Seafood brings fresh flavor to Joe Wheeler State Park
item.description: Lash's Seafood quickly became a favorite among Joe Wheeler State Park visitors last year by offering fresh dishes and personalized, hometown hospitality.

item.title: River Region Veterans Coalition to host candidate forum for 2026 general election
item.description: The River Region Veterans Coalition will host a nonpartisan candidate forum this July to discuss issues impacting veterans and the broader community.

item.title: Inaugural Gee's Bend Spring Yard Show celebrates local quilting tradition
item.description: The inaugural open-air gathering on April 25 will feature quilts, handiwork and local history displayed directly from residents' own yards in Wilcox County.

item.title: Sen. Britt attends Hadrian shipbuilding factory ribbon cutting in Cherokee
item.description: The $2 billion public-private partnership will bring up to 1,000 skilled jobs to the Shoals region, boosting the local economy and maritime industrial base.

item.title: Dakarai Larriett speaks out against CAW firings, removal of fluoride from water supply
item.description: The Democratic U.S. Senate candidate criticized the utility's recent mass layoffs as corporate irresponsibility and warned the policy changes threatened public health.

item.title: Gov. Ivey awards $460M to expand broadband
item.description: Investment will bring high-speed internet to 92,000 locations, strengthening economic growth, education access and long-term infrastructure across Alabama.

item.title: Alabama joins 20 other states, urging SCOTUS to review appellate voting law decision
item.description: Alabama joined a multistate effort last week, asking the Supreme Court to restore state authority over election laws in the mail-in ballot dating requirement.

item.title: Alabama bets in the shadows as lawmakers stall on sports wagering
item.description: Illegal and unregulated betting is expanding across Alabama, exposing consumers to risk while lawmakers delay action and forfeit millions in potential revenue.

item.title: UA students sue university over suspended student publications
item.description: A group of University of Alabama students filed a federal lawsuit on Wednesday, challenging the university’s suspension of two student magazines.
